appraisal_events.evidence: l'air qu'elle eut de ne pas prendre ma prière en considération ni même au sérieux... je me sentais seul. Les choses m'étaient devenues étrangères... je n'étais plus qu'un cœur qui battait et qu'une attention suivant anxieusement le développement de « sole mio »
appraisal_events.explanation: The mother's refusal to take her son's plea seriously, followed by her departure for the station, precipitates a narrated collapse of the narrator's grip on reality and self, leaving him isolated, paralyzed, and in mounting despair.

status_effects.explanation: He is plunged into desolate solitude, stripped of his mother's consoling presence and of any stable sense of Venice or himself.
His initial assertion of will ('cette volonté de lutte') collapses into paralysis: he proves unable even to decide to rise and follow his mother, undercutting the defiance he set out to display.
